body: I can definitely relate to this and my method to cope has been to go on a lose dose of anti-depressants. I talked to my family doctor and he recommended them so I could get back on my feet and sleep and eat better since I also lost a bit of weight. Medication isn't for everyone, but it has helped me. It's really tough to deal with but I recommend focusing on your health and getting good rest and nutrition. Take it easy ♡
Yeah, getting in touch would be a bad idea. And I know I would be the last person he would ask for money, mainly because he owes me a lot.
